lines.text: The Lord gives the command;
a great company of women proclaim it:
“Kings and their armies flee in haste;
she who waits at home divides the plunder.
Though you lie down among the sheepfolds,
the wings of the dove are covered with silver,
and her feathers with shimmering gold.”
When the Almighty scattered the kings in the land,
it was like the snow falling on Zalmon.
A mountain of God is Mount Bashan;
a mountain of many peaks is Mount Bashan.
Why do you gaze in envy, O mountains of many peaks?
This is the mountain God chose for His dwelling,
where the LORD will surely dwell forever.
The chariots of God are tens of thousands—
thousands of thousands are they;
the Lord is in His sanctuary
as He was at Sinai.
You have ascended on high;
You have led captives away.
You have received gifts from men,
even from the rebellious,
that the LORD God may dwell there.
Blessed be the Lord,
who daily bears our burden,
the God of our salvation.
Selah

pictures.scene: Pieter Gerardus van Os, Landschap met vee — the cattle lying full and quiet in the open pasture, O God from Your bounty You provided for the poor, the Lord gives the command
pictures.name: pd_van_os_landschap_met_vee

pictures.scene: Jan Victors, De groentewinkel — the women crowded round the heaped baskets with the word passing between them, a great company of women proclaim it, kings and their armies flee in haste
pictures.name: pd_victors_de_groentewinkel

pictures.scene: Christoffel Bisschop, Een zonnig plekje — the woman left at home at her work in the one patch of sun, she who waits at home divides the plunder, though you lie down among the sheepfolds
pictures.name: pd_bisschop_een_zonnig_plekje

pictures.scene: Jakob Bogdani, Vogels in een park — the white doves among the bright birds with the light on their feathers, the wings of the dove are covered with silver, and her feathers with shimmering gold
pictures.name: pd_bogdani_vogels_in_een_park

pictures.scene: Julius von Klever, Winterlandschap met berk — the snow lying over everything with the last light behind the bare tree, when the Almighty scattered the kings in the land, it was like the snow falling on Zalmon
pictures.name: pd_klever_winterlandschap_met_berk

pictures.scene: Albert Bierstadt, The Rocky Mountains, Lander's Peak — the snow peaks standing up one behind another over the valley, a mountain of God is Mount Bashan, a mountain of many peaks is Mount Bashan
pictures.name: pd_bierstadt_landers_peak

pictures.scene: Benjamin Prins, Stadsgezicht met romaanse kerk — the great church standing over the town it was built in, this is the mountain God chose for His dwelling, where the LORD will surely dwell forever
pictures.name: pd_prins_stadsgezicht_met_romaanse_kerk

pictures.scene: Gerrit Berckheyde, De Grote of Sint-Bavokerk te Haarlem — the huge church filling the square with the people small at its foot, where the LORD will surely dwell forever, the chariots of God are tens of thousands
pictures.name: pd_berckheyde_bavokerk

pictures.scene: Paolo Uccello, The Battle of San Romano — the lances and the horses massed across the whole field, thousands of thousands are they, the Lord is in His sanctuary
pictures.name: pd_uccello_battle_of_san_romano

pictures.scene: Caspar David Friedrich, Der Wanderer über dem Nebelmeer — the man standing on the rock above the cloud with the peaks beyond, as He was at Sinai, You have ascended on high
pictures.name: pd_friedrich_wanderer_nebelmeer

pictures.scene: Diego Velázquez, The Surrender of Breda — the beaten commander handing the key of the city up to the victor, You have led captives away, You have received gifts from men
pictures.name: pd_velazquez_surrender_of_breda

pictures.scene: Rembrandt, The Return of the Prodigal Son — the father's hands laid on the ragged son kneeling home at last, even from the rebellious, that the LORD God may dwell there
pictures.name: pd_rembrandt_prodigal_son

pictures.scene: Honoré Daumier, The Laundress — the woman climbing the steps with the day's washing and her child by the hand, blessed be the Lord, who daily bears our burden
pictures.name: pd_daumier_the_laundress

pictures.scene: Rembrandt, The Storm on the Sea of Galilee — the boat driven up the wave with the men clinging on and the Lord among them, the God of our salvation, Selah
pictures.name: pd_rembrandt_storm_on_galilee
